result.brief: 提出 StreamEval 交互式流式视频生成统一基准，覆盖数字人对话、世界生成与指令/参考编辑五类任务，含 300 个长时序脚本用例与十项任务特定指标，评测 37 个模型并揭示请求执行与状态一致性瓶颈。
result.reason: Benchmark for interactive streaming video generation covering world generation, editing and audiovisual coordination; directly serves video generation evaluation and streaming world models.
